findings.statement: Coinbase says cbXRP is a Coinbase Wrapped Asset on Base backed 1:1 by native XRP in custody; eligible Coinbase Exchange deposits are automatically unwrapped and credited as native XRP.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Mechanism existence does not prove a specific liquidator used it.

findings.statement: A third-party index attributes 132 cbXRP/USDC Morpho liquidations to 0x4c0f…19f4, with $1.07478M debt repaid and $136.24K bonus during activity ending October 8.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: One provider and one address; not total market liquidations or verified beneficial owner.

findings.statement: One event in a 30-liquidation batch seized 701.6 cbXRP for 829.4 USDC debt and $105.09 bonus; retained proceeds were not measured.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: No subsequent redemption or sale shown.

findings.statement: Clearstar's vault displays $410.85K allocation to the cbXRP 62.5% LLTV market, $6.47M underlying market liquidity, 90.07% utilization and 5.86% APY.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: One vault position is not total market supply or Coinbase volume.

findings.statement: A separate cbXRP/USDC Morpho market with 77% LLTV displays $456.95K supply, $394.46K borrowed, $62.65K available and 86.29% utilization.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: No proof Coinbase routes borrowers to this market.

findings.statement: Morpho documents public REST endpoints for Blue market state, parameters, APY averages, positions and historical data; Barrot has not executed the API.
findings.disconfirming_evidence: Documentation is not evidence of production ingestion or complete coverage.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Morpho cbXRP liquidation can create native XRP supply pressure if the liquidator deposits seized cbXRP to Coinbase, receives native XRP and then sells or transfers it.
supporting_evidence: Morpho liquidation transfers cbXRP to liquidators.
Coinbase officially accepts cbXRP deposits and automatically credits native XRP.
disconfirming_evidence: No liquidator-to-Coinbase deposit, unwrap or native XRP sale was traced.
The 701.6 cbXRP event's retained proceeds were not measured.
unknowns: Coinbase deposit attribution and unwrap timing.
Native XRP sale venue, size and time.

competing_hypotheses.claim: cbXRP lending adds collateral utility but exposes borrowers to liquidation; distinct LLTV markets can fragment risk and liquidity.
supporting_evidence: Historical liquidation events and curated-vault allocations are visible.
disconfirming_evidence: Market balances are not Coinbase interface volumes.
Seized cbXRP can be held or traded on Base without becoming native XRP supply.
unknowns: Coinbase market routing and customer share.

competing_hypotheses.claim: One automated liquidator has been an important participant in cbXRP/USDC liquidations.
supporting_evidence: 132 events, $1.07478M debt repaid and $136.24K bonus attributed to 0x4c0f…19f4.
disconfirming_evidence: One provider's coverage ends Oct 8; other liquidators exist; address does not identify a person or institution.
unknowns: Operator, beneficial owner and current balances.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 62.5% LLTV market is the sole market behind Coinbase's XRP-backed loan interface.
supporting_evidence: Prior market analytics associated the 62.5% market with Coinbase's product.
disconfirming_evidence: A separate 77% LLTV cbXRP/USDC market exists; Coinbase does not publish market IDs.
unknowns: Exact Coinbase market routing and whether it uses multiple markets.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Morpho curated-vault allocations represent Circle or Coinbase as direct USDC lenders.
supporting_evidence: USDC is the debt asset and Coinbase integrates Morpho.
disconfirming_evidence: Vaults aggregate independent supplier capital; no direct Circle/Coinbase supplier position was identified.
unknowns: Underlying supplier identities and beneficial owners.

relationship_edges.details: One event seized 701.6 cbXRP for 829.4 USDC debt repaid; the wider index attributes 132 cbXRP/USDC events to 0x4c0f…19f4.
Eligible users depositing cbXRP receive the underlying native XRP credit.
Mechanism exists; no liquidator-to-Coinbase transfer, unwrap or native XRP sale was traced.
$410.85K allocation and $6.47M underlying market liquidity; one vault, not total market or Coinbase volume.
Distinct market with its own supply, borrow, oracle, utilization and liquidation penalty.
Coinbase confirms Morpho integration; multiple cbXRP markets exist and no exclusive market should be assumed.

relationship_edges.to_entity: Blue market state and historical series
relationship_edges.details: Public GET endpoints can support market-state ingestion; API calls have not yet been executed.

next_actions: Trace 0x4c0f and 0xa5e989 cbXRP balances/transfers after liquidations using the official Base cbXRP contract.
Look for Coinbase Exchange cbXRP deposit/unwrap events linked to those liquidators; do not infer identity from proximity.
Reconcile 62.5% and 77% market IDs, oracles, LLTVs, supply/borrow, collateral at risk and curator/vault exposure.
Execute read-only Morpho REST API queries and validate pagination, timestamps and rate limits.
Keep liquidation/unwrap metrics separate from spot-market supply and Coinbase product volume.
